index.title: ARC Starter Templates — One-click site demos for WordPress

hero.title: Effortless Website Creation<br class="hidden sm:block" /> Starts Here.
hero.lead: ARC Starter Templates imports complete Tailwind sites into WordPress in one click — Elementor-editable or Gutenberg blocks, images in your Media Library, menus and front page wired automatically.

index.intro: Pick a demo, run the step-by-step wizard and get a full site — pages, images, menus and settings — in under a minute. The plugin stays lightweight: template documents and images live in this repository and download on demand at import time.

demos.title: {count} Free Templates for All Purposes.
demos.lead: Corporate, e-commerce, blog, nonprofit and more — each design is a complete multi-page site, tailored for one-click import.

features.title: Key Features.
features.lead: Everything a starter-template plugin should do — and nothing it shouldn't.

items.title: One-click import wizard
items.text: Step-by-step Media → Pages → Setup flow with live progress, per-page selection, dry-run and optional reset.

items.title: Elementor or Gutenberg
items.text: With Elementor pages import as native container/widget layouts; without it they land as editable block pages.

items.title: Remote payload
items.text: Manifest, documents and images live in this repo — the plugin stays light and every import pulls the latest state.

items.title: Media Library images
items.text: Every image downloads into your Media Library on import and template URLs are rewritten to it.

items.title: Menus & front page
items.text: Home is set as the front page and the demo's Main + Footer menus are assigned to the theme locations.

items.title: Working contact form
items.text: Configurable recipient, honeypot, consent checkbox and a Form Entries panel storing every submission.

items.title: Block patterns
items.text: Every imported page is also registered under the ARC Starter Templates pattern category.

items.title: WP-CLI ready
items.text: wp arc-st import, reset and status — provision headless sites from the command line.

ecosystem.title: One system, three pieces.
ecosystem.lead: The repo, the plugin and the theme work as one — each stays small on its own, together they build the whole site.

items.title: tema — the payload
items.text: Templates, images and the manifest live here. Imports always pull the latest state, so updating a template here ships it everywhere the plugin points.

items.title: ARC Starter Templates
items.text: Reads this repo remotely and turns each demo into real pages — Gutenberg blocks or Elementor layouts, Media Library images, menus, front page and a built-in chat bot.

items.title: Lienzo Astra
items.text: Supplies the chrome around imported pages — header, menus, logo and fonts — plus Customizer controls: template color palettes and markdown copy overrides that re-skin any imported demo.

ecosystem.note: Change a template here → the plugin imports it → the theme frames and re-skins it. Everything stays connected.

setup.title: Connect the plugin to this repo.
setup.lead: wp-admin → ARC Templates → Templates repository → Remote base URL. This repo is public — leave the access token empty and every import pulls the latest state.

steps.title: Install & activate
steps.text: Copy the plugin to wp-content/plugins and activate ARC Starter Templates.

steps.title: Paste the remote URL
steps.text: ARC Templates → Templates repository → Remote base URL.

steps.title: Import a demo
steps.text: Open the library, click a card and run the wizard — done in under a minute.

cta.title: Experience the power of one-click starter sites.
cta.text: Activate ARC Starter Templates, point it at this repository and import your first demo today.

plugin.title: ARC Starter Templates — the plugin

hero.title: The importer.<br class="hidden sm:block" /> One click, a whole site.
hero.lead: ARC Starter Templates turns any demo in this repository into real WordPress pages — Elementor containers or native Gutenberg blocks — with images in your Media Library, menus assigned and the front page set, all from a step-by-step wizard.

plugin.intro: Every demo in the marquee above is one import away — the plugin pulls this repo's manifest, downloads each page and its images on demand, and leaves behind a real WordPress site you own and can edit.

sections.title: Everything the importer does.
sections.lead: A solace-extra style library screen, a resilient wizard and a full site-setup pass — designed to never touch content it didn't create.

items.title: Import wizard
items.text: Media → Pages → Setup with a live progress log, per-page selection, dry-run mode and an optional reset of previously imported pages.

items.title: Elementor native
items.text: Pages import as flexbox container/widget layouts (Elementor 3.16+); brand colors and Outfit land in the kit as globals and the CSS cache is rebuilt.

items.title: Gutenberg fallback
items.text: Without Elementor the same pages become native blocks — groups, headings, images with Media Library ids — fully editable in the block editor.

items.title: Remote payload
items.text: Manifest, documents and images live in this repo and download on demand into uploads/arc-st-remote/. Set the base URL, a constant or a filter.

items.title: Resilient runs
items.text: Run lock, server-side progress with Resume/Retry, per-file media error reporting and environment checks — nothing fails silently.

items.title: Site setup
items.text: Home becomes the front page, the demo's Main + Footer menus take the theme's locations, and the logo doubles as custom logo and site icon.

items.title: Contact + entries
items.text: Working form with configurable recipient, honeypot and consent checkbox — every submission stored in the Form Entries panel.

items.title: Patterns & WP-CLI
items.text: Every page registers under the ARC Starter Templates pattern category; wp arc-st import/reset/status provisions headless sites.

sections.title: How an import runs.
sections.lead: Click a card in ARC Templates → Library and the wizard does the rest — resume-safe if anything interrupts it.

items.title: Media
items.text: Every image the demo references is downloaded into the Media Library and template URLs are rewritten to it.

items.title: Pages
items.text: Pages are created first, then filled — so cross-links and CTAs resolve to real permalinks instead of dead "#" hrefs.

items.title: Setup
items.text: Front page, menus, logo and site icon are wired. Re-importing updates the same pages — it never duplicates them.

sections.title: Headless with WP-CLI.
sections.lead: Provision sites from the command line — same importer, no wp-admin required.

sections.title: Requirements & safety.
sections.lead: Built to coexist with real sites — the importer only touches what it creates.

items.title: WordPress 6.0+ · PHP 7.4+
items.text: Tested up to WP 6.7; warns about missing extensions or a non-writable uploads directory.

items.title: Elementor optional
items.text: 3.16+ with flexbox containers enabled for Elementor layouts; native blocks otherwise.

items.title: Never edits your content
items.text: The wizard only creates its own pages, menus and uploads — the reset removes only what it imported.

items.title: Theme overrides
items.text: A template at arc-starter-templates/<demo>/<page>.html inside the theme wins over the bundled copy — edit in the theme, re-import.

theme.title: Lienzo Astra — the theme

hero.title: The chrome around<br class="hidden sm:block" /> every imported site.
hero.lead: Lienzo Astra is a lightweight, accessible base theme — a rebuilt, de-branded Hello Elementor derivative — with an Astra-inspired Design Options panel, full Elementor Theme Builder support and native integration with ARC Starter Templates.

theme.intro: Activate it once and forget it — Lienzo Astra draws the header, menus and footer around whatever the plugin imports, and its Design Options panel re-skins the whole site without touching a single template file.

sections.title: Small theme, full stack.
sections.lead: Everything a base theme should ship — and a switch under Appearance → Lienzo to turn each piece off.

items.title: Design Options
items.text: Astra-style Customizer panel: colors, typography, layout widths, logo position, sticky header and footer colors — all with live preview.

items.title: Elementor Theme Builder
items.text: Registers every location — header, footer, single, archive, search, 404 — plus Lienzo Header/Footer tabs inside Site Settings.

items.title: Lienzo widgets
items.text: Breadcrumbs, Dark Mode Switcher and Reading Time under their own widget category — drop them into any Theme Builder template.

items.title: SEO built in
items.text: Canonicals, meta descriptions, Open Graph/Twitter cards and a JSON-LD graph — steps aside when Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO or TSF is active.

items.title: Dark mode & extras
items.text: Site-wide dark mode that respects prefers-color-scheme and remembers the choice, plus a back-to-top button and reading progress bar.

items.title: Fast & hardened
items.text: Reversible tweaks: no emoji scripts, RSD/shortlink cleanup, dashicons off the front end, pingbacks disabled — each behind its own filter.

items.title: Patterns & palettes
items.text: 8 core-block patterns under a Lienzo Astra category; preset palettes sync into theme.json so blocks follow the Customizer.

items.title: WooCommerce ready
items.text: Products per row and per page, a header cart icon with live count and a dedicated shop wrapper — plus editor styles and RTL sheets.

sections.title: Built for ARC Starter Templates.
sections.lead: The theme detects imported pages and gets out of the way — while keeping full control of the chrome around them.

items.title: Full-width canvas
items.text: On ARC pages the boxed container, page title, breadcrumbs, comments and floating buttons step aside; only the chrome stylesheet stays.

items.title: Template overrides
items.text: Drop arc-starter-templates/<demo>/<page>.html inside the theme and it wins over the plugin's copy — edit the HTML in the theme, re-import.

items.title: Editor in sync
items.text: The demo's palette and Outfit font merge into the theme.json layers, so imported designs appear as real presets in block controls.

sections.title: Design Options, panel by panel.
sections.lead: Appearance → Customize → Design Options — the quick-styling controls Astra users expect, reimplemented from scratch.

items.title: Colors
items.text: Primary, link, text and background colors plus preset palettes synced to the block editor.

items.title: Typography
items.text: Body & heading fonts with Google Fonts preconnect and a base font-size control.

items.title: Layout
items.text: Container and content widths, with wide alignment support in the editor.

items.title: Header & footer
items.text: Logo position and width, sticky header, footer colors and copyright text.

items.title: Blog
items.text: Featured images on archives, post meta on single posts and excerpt length.

items.title: WooCommerce
items.text: Products per row and per page, plus a header cart with a live count badge.

cta.title: Theme frames it, plugin builds it.
cta.text: Activate Lienzo Astra, install ARC Starter Templates and import a demo — header, menus and palette included.
